plugins.name: issue-board
plugins.description: The repository's open GitHub issues and pull requests in a pane and the status line, with acceptance progress and CI, and a button that hands an issue to Claude.

plugins.name: turn-recap
plugins.description: Sums up each turn on its 'Baked for 3s' line (tools run, failures, files edited), and lists every file Claude edited this session in a /touched pane.

plugins.name: type-ahead
plugins.description: Pause while typing a prompt and Haiku offers up to three ways your sentence could go on, drawn from the conversation, listed above the prompt with the selected one previewed dim in the box: alt+↑/↓ cycle, alt+→ takes it, Enter sends what you typed.

plugins.name: plain-english
plugins.description: Makes Claude write in short, plain English sentences, and refuses commit messages, PRs, Markdown files and replies that show the usual signs of AI-written text. /plain-english on|off switches it.
